title: 1811 Slave Revolt Tour at Destrehan Plantation
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step into one of the most powerful and haunting chapters of Louisiana history with our immersive 1811 Slave Revolt Experience at Destrehan Plantation. Journey back to the night when hundreds of enslaved men and women risked everything in pursuit of freedom during the largest slave uprising in U.S. history. Walk the grounds where rebellion once echoed through the cane fields, and hear the true stories of courage, resistance, fear, and survival that forever changed the region. Through dramatic storytelling & deeply researched historical accounts, guests will uncover the hidden realities of plantation life and the brave individuals who stood against unimaginable oppression in 1811 Louisiana. Hear chilling narratives, designed to educate, move, and leave a lasting impression. Perfect for history lovers seeking something beyond the ordinary New Orleans experience. Walk the grounds where rebellion rose. Book your unforgettable journey into the shadows of 1811 at Destrehan Plantation today.
